department: Department of Physics, Ph.D. in Astronomy and Astrophysics

deadline.value: Applications are due December 15 to begin in the fall of the following year.
deadline.quote: Applications should be complete and submitted by December 15 to begin study in the fall semester of the following year.

fee_waiver.value: The fee cannot be waived except for GEM Fellowship and Rales Fellowship applicants.
fee_waiver.quote: We regret that it is not possible to waive this small fee, with the exception of specific cases (at present for GEM Fellowship and Rales Fellowship applicants only).

gre_general.value: GRE General or Subject scores are optional.
gre_general.quote: GRE: GRE General or GRE Subject Test scores are optional.

gre_subject.quote: GRE: GRE General or GRE Subject Test scores are optional.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT composite minimum is 86 for this program.
toefl_min.quote: Composite Score TOEFL IBT, TOEFL Home: 86

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic overall 6.5, with 6.0 for speaking and writing.

english_waiver.value: The exemption needs an undergraduate degree from an English-speaking program in an English-speaking country, so an Indian degree does not qualify.
english_waiver.quote: and who have not completed an undergraduate degree at an English speaking program in an English-speaking country

supervisor.value: Students identify a research advisor and join a group within the first two weeks of their first semester.
supervisor.quote: Each student is expected to identify a research advisor and join a research group within the first two weeks of their first semester.

funding.value: The department says it gives substantial support to doctoral students, but not that all or most are funded.
funding.quote: The Physics Department provides substantial financial support for doctoral students

entry_route.value: Applicants finishing a B.S., B.A. or M.S. in Astronomy, Physics or a closely related subject are considered.
entry_route.quote: Students who are finishing a B.S., B.A. or M.S. degree in Astronomy and Astrophysics, Physics or a closely related subject will be considered for admission

notes: Run inside the Physics department; the program has its own handbook and page.
